decisions.reason: It supports the firm's publicly stated push into secure cross-channel communication, builds directly on its core authentication platform, and continued website presence makes management likely to justify and extend the prior investment rather than exit.

A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is highly central to the firm's technical identity-security positioning, and its dedicated page signals visible commitment that encourages continued backing despite any mixed short-term results.

The QR-code hardware signature token is close to the firm's established offer and to its online-signing direction, and the dedicated page suggests enough sunk development and reputational commitment for management to persist.

The compliance suite fits the firm's regulated-security customer base and broader ecosystem strategy, so in a growing industry management would be inclined to keep leveraging earlier R&D and market commitment rather than withdraw.
